notice rank=3 index=89.96
steps.detail: Your firm sold nothing in round 1, so it did not compete this round. A firm that does not compete is placed below every firm that did, whatever its score — so your firm was ranked 3 in this round’s standings with a performance index of 89.96, below firms whose index was lower than yours. The index itself was not reduced; only the placing. Sell in at least one market next round to be ranked on your score again.
